meanings: to guard against, to exhort, to admonish or warn, to give up or stop doing sth, Buddhist monastic discipline, ring (for a finger)
to arrive at (place or time), period, to become due, classifier for events, meetings, elections, sporting fixtures, years (of graduation)
despite, although, even though, in spite of, unhesitatingly, do not hesitate (to ask, complain etc), (go ahead and do it) without hesitating
as far as possible, to do one's utmost
